channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Rubio backs blockade, Vance wants deal: Is Trump’s team split on Iran war?
item.description: Torn between military action and diplomacy, US appears to settle for drawn-out economic pressure campaign, blockade.

item.title: Rights group raises concerns about jailed Dr Abu Safia amid strikes on Gaza
item.description: PHRI says the arbitrary detention of Gaza doctors violates individual rights and undermines healthcare system.

item.title: Israel kills Gaza goalkeeper days after playing in cup for slain athletes
item.description: Mahmoud Abdel-Malek, a 20-year-old goalkeeper for Gaza Sports Club, was killed in an Israeli airstrike on Gaza City.

item.title: Workers across Spain stage first general strike in 14 years
item.description: Strike disrupts public transport and industries amid demands for housing reform ahead of November 29 elections.

item.title: US Treasury chief Bessent moved to military base after ‘Iranian threats’
item.description: Iran is said to have geo-located Bessent's $12.5m mansion in Washington, DC after a photo of it was published.

item.title: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
item.description: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.

item.title: Four grizzly bears killed in Canada after fatal attack on mother and daughter
item.description: The sow and her three cubs were responsible for killing Jennifer Balcarras, 48, and her daughter Selah Reed, 20, earlier this month.
